title: Turns Ratio Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly calculate the transformer turns ratio n₁/n₂ = 2 using the given power relationships and circuit constraints.

title: Input Voltage Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: Student must determine that the input voltage U_AB is twice the bulb voltage when the bulb glows normally.

title: Power Relationship Analysis
description: Important Criteria: Student must correctly apply the given condition P_R₁ = 8P_bulb to establish relationships between currents and voltages.

title: Transformer Current Ratio
description: Important Criteria: Student must use the transformer relationship I₁/I₂ = n₂/n₁ along with circuit analysis to solve for unknowns.

title: Circuit Equivalent Resistance
description: Important Criteria: Student must analyze the primary side circuit with parallel resistors R₁ and R₂ to find equivalent resistance seen by the transformer.

title: Resistance Ratio Application
description: Optional Criteria: Student may explicitly use the given relationship R₁ = R₂ = 2R_bulb in their calculations.

title: Sign Error in Ratios
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student incorrectly inverts the transformer ratio (e.g., writes n₁/n₂ = 1/2 instead of 2).

title: Power Formula Misapplication
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if student incorrectly applies P = I²R or P = V²/R to wrong circuit elements or mismatches voltages/currents.
